debt.maturity_date_src: Exact maturity dates from the key-terms tables of prior 10-Ks / 8-Ks (e.g. FY2022-FY2024 10-K indebtedness notes, 8-K note issuances); the 2024 Senior Notes due 2034 exact day is not in the downloaded documents (issued 5-Aug-2024).

commercial_paper_program.text: At June 30, 2026, Moody's had $7.1 billion of outstanding principal on debt and $1 billion of additional capacity available under the Company's CP Program, which is backstopped by the $1.25 billion 2024 Facility.

revolving_credit_facility.name: 2024 Credit Facility
revolving_credit_facility.pricing: adjusted term SOFR + 80.5 to 122.5 bps; quarterly fee 7 to 15 bps (by index debt ratings)
revolving_credit_facility.covenant: total debt to EBITDA not more than 4.0x (4.5x for the first three quarters after an acquisition with consideration > $500m)
revolving_credit_facility.drawn_note: Undrawn at 31-Dec-2025 (10-K); Q2-26 10-Q states $1bn CP capacity backstopped by the facility and no borrowings are shown on the balance sheet.

debt.net_investment_hedges: EUR 500m of the 2015 Notes due 2027 and EUR 750m of the 2019 Notes due 2030 designated as net investment hedges; cross-currency swaps: pay EUR 2,197m fixed (2.63%) / receive $2,353m (4.11%); pay EUR 1,688m ESTR / receive $1,750m SOFR; HKD/USD and SGD/HKD swaps.
debt.future_interest_payments: Future interest payments and fees associated with the Company's debt and credit facility are expected to be $3.4 billion, of which approximately $200 million is expected to be paid in each of the next five years.
debt.notes: 2017 Senior Notes due 2028 swap ($500m notional at 31-Dec-2025) no longer outstanding at 30-Jun-2026. Euro note principal translated at 30-Jun-2026 rates as shown (571 / 857).
debt.summary: 30-Jun-2026 (Q2-26 10-Q Note 13): 14 senior notes, $7,128m principal / $6,946m carrying value (current portion $571m = €500m 1.75% due Mar-2027); commercial paper programme $1.0bn undrawn; 2024 Credit Facility $1.25bn to May-2029 undrawn (covenant total debt / EBITDA ≤ 4.0x).
debt.cp_note: Commercial paper ($1.0bn programme, backstopped by the $1.25bn 2024 Credit Facility; nil at 30-Jun-2026) is drawn when cash would fall below the minimum balance and repaid from surplus cash.
